newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down in weak market.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down in weak market.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices drifted further south at the close, as sellers continued to court buyers with cheaper rates, traders said.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 at 290.50 cents ($1.16) a kg, down a cent from Wednesday. May SMR20 buyer was half cent lower at 276.

Trading houses quoted the SMR CV at 346 cents, SMR L at 325, SMR 10 at 278 and drum latex at 233-235 cents FOB. "We have reduced prices as much as we can. We are in fact at a discount now with Thailand and Indonesia," said an industry official.
